moves.name: Frenzied Sludge Wave
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When there is at least one Pokémon affected by a status condition on the opponent’s field of play.
Deactivation Condition:
When there are no longer any Pokémon affected by a status condition on the opponent’s field of play.

Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Has a chance ([Digit:2digits ]%) of leaving the target poisoned. This attack’s power increases 50% when the terrain is [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="3" ].
